question: In which Union Territories will the 5th edition of Khelo India Winter Games 2025 be held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **5th edition** of the **Khelo India Winter Games 2025** is scheduled to be hosted in the Union Territories of **Jammu & Kashmir** and **Ladakh**.
 
• This prestigious national-level multi-sport event is organized annually to promote the culture of **winter sports** across India and to identify talent for international competitions like the **Winter Olympics**.
 
• The games are conducted under the flagship **Khelo India Programme**, which is an initiative of the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India.
